question: Which of the following allows users to delete a file using the mouse?

options.text: Drag it to the Recycle Bin

solution:
The correct answer is __**Drag it to the Recycle Bin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Recycle Bin** is a special folder in the **Windows operating system** where deleted files and folders are temporarily stored. This allows users to restore accidentally deleted items if needed.
 
• To delete a file using the mouse, you can simply **drag the file** or folder from its original location to the Recycle Bin icon on the desktop. This action moves the file to the Recycle Bin and does not permanently delete it.
 
• Dragging a file to the Recycle Bin is a simple and efficient way to delete a file without using any keyboard shortcuts or additional software.
 
• This method ensures that the file can still be retrieved if needed, as it is not permanently removed from the system until the Recycle Bin is emptied manually. Hence, the correct answer is Drag it to the Recycle Bin.<
